_doc: The Storyteller event deck. scope: home (a household, or a townie lot played statistically when 'lot' is true), district (somewhere in a district; ripples outward), town. size: small|medium|big. tone: good|bad|mixed. cat is the category the player can switch off. incident = an existing incident id forced on the target (lot|folk|townie). Pure cards use fx (see storyteller_fx.gd). options = a player choice (townies take 'auto'). weight 0 = only reachable through a chain or a ripple follow-up. when: tier (rich|poor), coins_min/max, adult, job, nojob, partner, pets, mature (needs the Mature life events setting), min_day. wealth = weight multipliers for rich / poor households. signs = foreshadowing lines (shown before medium and big bad events, never saying what is coming).

found_money.title: Found some money
found_money.removed: coins from nowhere: no culprit, no loss for anyone

signs: The tap has been dripping and the pipes knock at night.

Someone was seen looking over the fence.

stranger_arrives.title: A stranger in town

when.removed: creates a townie from nothing: needs a vacant home and a mover

stranger_arrives.text: A stranger, {other}, has just moved to town and stopped to ask {name} for directions.

options.label: Say hello
options.text: {name} and {other} chatted for a while.

options.label: Keep your distance
options.text: {name} pointed the way and moved on.

secret_out.title: A secret comes out

when.removed: a leak with no real secret: needs the real secret and gossip system to roll it

secret_out.text: Word has got around about something {name} hoped to keep quiet. {other} is the one telling it.
signs: People go quiet when {name} walks into a room.

options.label: Own up
options.text: {name} told everyone the truth before it grew. It stung, but people respected it.

options.label: Deny it
options.text: {name} denied everything.

options.label: Laugh it off
options.text: {name} laughed it off, a little too loudly.

anonymous_letter.title: An unsigned letter
anonymous_letter.text: An unsigned letter came for {name}. It says someone has noticed everything {name} has been up to lately, and is not sure what to think of it.

options.label: Read it out to the household
options.text: The household read it together. Nobody could say who wrote it.

options.label: Show it to the police
options.text: The police took a note and said there was nothing to worry about.

options.label: Burn it
options.text: {name} burned the letter and tried to forget it.

old_flame.title: An old flame returns
old_flame.text: {other}, an old flame, has turned up in town and left a note for {name}.
signs: Someone from the past was asking about {name} at the café.

options.label: Catch up over coffee
options.text: {name} and {other} caught up over coffee.

options.label: Politely decline
options.text: {name} wished {other} well and kept things short.

rival_next_door.title: A rival moves in
rival_next_door.text: {other} has moved in next door, and made it plain they think they are better than {name}.

options.label: Take over a pie (10 coins)
options.text: {other} softened a little at the sight of the pie.

options.label: Ignore them
options.text: {name} decided not to give {other} the satisfaction.

options.label: Compete
options.text: {name} and {other} began a quiet war over whose garden looked better.

mysterious_inheritance.title: A mysterious inheritance
mysterious_inheritance.text: A solicitor's letter says a distant relative nobody remembers has left {name} something.

options.label: Accept it
options.text: The money arrived, and with it a lot of questions.

options.label: Look into it first (100 coins)
options.text: The solicitor dug further. The estate was not what it seemed.

pet_on_doorstep.title: A pet at the door
pet_on_doorstep.text: A friendly stray turned up on the doorstep.
pet_on_doorstep.lot_text: A friendly stray turned up on {name}'s doorstep.

options.label: Take them in
options.text: {name} took {pet} in. They have a new friend.

options.label: Take them to the shelter
options.text: The shelter will find them a home.

headhunter.title: A job headhunter

when.removed: a job offer from nowhere: the job board and the career system make real offers

headhunter.text: {other}, a recruiter, rang {name} with an offer that sounds too good to ignore.

options.label: Hear them out
options.text: {other} sent the details over.

options.label: Stay loyal to the boss
options.text: {name}'s boss heard about it and gave them a small thank-you.

contest.title: A local contest
contest.text: There is a local contest this week, with a small prize for the winner.

options.label: Enter (10 coins)
options.text: {name} entered the contest.

options.label: Skip it
options.text: {name} stayed home.

lost_wallet.title: A lost wallet
lost_wallet.text: {name} found a wallet on the pavement. The ID inside says it belongs to {other}.

options.label: Return it
options.text: {other} was so grateful they pressed a reward into {name}'s hand.

options.label: Keep it
options.text: {name} kept the money and felt uneasy about it.

neighbour_favour.title: A neighbour asks a favour
neighbour_favour.text: {other}, a neighbour, asked {name} for a small favour.

options.label: Help out
options.text: {name} lent a hand. {other} will remember it.

options.label: Say you are busy
options.text: {name} said it was a bad time.

work_power_struggle.title: A power struggle at work

when.removed: no real managers: pay or stress with no actor

work_power_struggle.text: Two managers are fighting over who runs the department, and both want {name} on their side.
signs: There are whispers and closed doors at work.

options.label: Pick a side
options.text: {name} backed a manager.

options.label: Stay neutral
options.text: {name} kept their head down.

audit.title: A tax audit

when.removed: no tax cause: a real audit needs a real tax record

audit.text: A letter says the household's accounts are being audited.
signs: A tax inspector was seen asking about the neighbours.

options.label: Hire an accountant (150 coins)
options.text: The accountant sorted it out quickly.

options.label: Handle it yourself
options.text: It took a week of paperwork.

gold_digger.title: A charming newcomer
gold_digger.text: {other}, a charming newcomer, keeps finding reasons to ask {name} about money.

options.label: Politely cut ties
options.text: {name} stayed friendly but firm.

options.label: Lend them 200 coins
options.text: {name} handed over the money.

ask_to_stay.title: Someone needs a bed
ask_to_stay.text: {other} has lost their home for a while and asked if they could stay with {name}.

options.label: Let them stay
options.text: {other} moved in on the sofa for a couple of days.

options.label: Say no
options.text: {name} could not make room.

mayor_scandal.text: The mayor is in the papers for the wrong reasons. People are asking what the council knew.
signs: The mayor's aide looks nervous in every photo.
mayor_scandal.news: A scandal at the town hall: the mayor is under pressure.

town_fair.text: The town fair is on this weekend. Stalls, music and half the town out in the sun.
town_fair.news: The town fair brought people out in the sunshine.

town.news: A house fire on {zone} had the fire brigade out.
